# Capstone Project - Clinic Management System

> **Code:** FR_MKP_PRJ_01
> **Level:** FR
> **Duration:** 6 weeks
> **Topics:** Spring Boot | React | PostgreSQL

---

## 1. Problem Statement

A private clinic runs its appointments on paper. Patients phone in, the
receptionist writes the booking down by hand, and examination records live in a
filing cabinet.

Build the system that replaces that process: patients book their own
appointments, the receptionist confirms them, and doctors see their own schedule
and record examination results.

**Bonus AI** — suggest the free slot that best fits a patient's history.

**Bonus third-party integration** — send appointment reminders by email or
messaging.

Both bonuses are optional. A team that skips both can still score full marks on
every task.

## 2. Tasks

### Task 1 - D01 Project Proposal (10%)

- State the system scope, the list of actors, and what is explicitly out of scope.
- Staffing plan: who owns which area across the three sprints.
- Due in Sprint 1.

### Task 2 - D02 Product Backlog and WBS (10%)

- Product backlog as user stories, each with acceptance criteria.
- WBS broken down to tasks one person can finish in one day.
- Every task carries an Assignee and an Estimate.
- Due in Sprint 1.

### Task 3 - D03 Requirement and Design Documents (15%)

- Use cases, ERD, and an architecture diagram.
- Diagrams must be **diagram-as-code** (`.drawio`, Mermaid, dbdiagram.io,
  PlantUML). Exported images are not accepted.
- Due in Sprint 2.

### Task 4 - D04 Source Code (30%)

- Public repository with a README stating how to run it.
- Spring Boot backend, React frontend, PostgreSQL database.
- Every query taking user-supplied data binds its parameters.
- Due in Sprint 3.

### Task 5 - D05 Final Presentation and Demo (10%)

- Live demo against a running system, not a recording.
- Every member presents the part they own.
- Due in Sprint 3.

### Task 6 - Sprint Process (10%)

- At the end of each sprint the team clears all five gates G1-G5 described in
  the project spec.
- This task scores the mean of the per-sprint checkpoint scores.

### Task 7 - Individual contribution (15%)

- Commit history under the member's own account.
- Their contribution line in each sprint review record, naming task ids.
- Their part of the defence, and their answers about the code they wrote.

## 3. Deliverables

- D01 and D02 are due at the end of Sprint 1; D03 at the end of Sprint 2; D04
  and D05 at the end of Sprint 3.
- Each sprint is submitted through all five gates in the project spec's
  `## Sprint checkpoint` section.
- Source code is submitted as an annotated git tag, never as an archive on Drive.
